  > 
  > Please read the text against the code and `results/` and reply here with, for each item, "confirmed" or the correction (the exact wording you would accept). The items where the description of the quantity matters most:
  > 1. **Protocol** (`protocol.tex`): fixed target design (30 % columns, five partitions per fold, S from the other 70 %); family = organisation + first two name tokens; grouped 10-fold; time-forward = expanding window with cuts at 55/70/85 % of the release order; fit-then-select-then-predict with only training rows; **LOBO reference = the lower-error of the factor-model and Ledoit-Wolf conditional predictors** (`refs.csv`, `lobo_source`); closure on mean squared standardised error; grid; k* censoring; "standardised RMSE = root of the mean over test models of the per-model mean squared error over target columns, on the original standardised scale".
  > 2. **Section 6.2-6.4 numbers**: closure at k=3 (0.81 / 0.82 / 0.96, factor model, greedy A, `closure.csv`); RMSE at k=3 and the references (`curves.csv`, `refs.csv`); Table 2 values; grid-averaged gaps and "% of random error" (`gap.csv`, `rel_gap_to_random` of the grid_avg row); gap per k as % of random error (5-18 % at k<=3, 1-5 % at k=10, <3 % at k=20); "greedy A obtains 40-70 % of the oracle's gap" (= greedy-A gap / oracle gap, grid-averaged, factor model); shift: grouped vs random RMSE at k=3 (0.616/0.604, 0.590/0.578, 0.534/0.467), time-forward (0.729, 0.740); bias at k=3 by strength quintile (`bias.csv`, predicted minus observed, standardised units of the training fold).
  > 3. **Theory** (`theory.tex`, `appendix.tex` B): Prop. 1, the Jensen lemma, the Chernoff remark and its numbers (551 / 742 / 57 / 459, "risk bound below the measured mean for k < 8-10 on the MTEB pools and 1.6-3.2 times above at k=30", "35 of 35 rows"); `DERIVATIONS.md` is the source of each. Please also check my sentence that the without-replacement case is checked numerically only.
  > 4. **Theory check** (Section 6.5, Tables 3-4 as delivered): the three tiers, the medians (0.5 % true; 26.7 % to 1.5 % fitted M=60..2000; 16-24 % bootstrap; 36 / 47 / 69 % real), "an offset of about 0.08 in squared standardised units", k-dependent part 8.5 / 3.2 / 23 %, correlation above 0.997, coherence 3-4 on the pools, gap to random 35-61 % of reducible risk, "sampled submodularity ratio 0.93-0.99 (an upper bound)".
  > 5. **History sweep** (6.6): "a quarter of the history models (about 29) stays within 10 % on MTEB-Eng; half on MTEB-Multi; all on HELM MMLU; random missingness to density 0.5; weak-model missingness fails at every density tried (0.3-0.7)".
  > 6. **Appendix A**: the pool construction rules, the 13 departures (a)-(h) as I condensed them, the secondary `allrest` design gaps (-0.049 / -0.065 / -0.054, factor model, `gap.csv`), the licences sentence, the run times.
  > 
  > Not asked: figures and tables (they are `figtab-repo`'s). Where the text overstates, say so; I will change the text, not the claim's evidence.
